answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1989 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the bridge. The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the cedar queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
